title: Model registry intake, format 1
description: What the init wizard collected: the harnesses the user runs, whether an Artificial Analysis key was saved, and the benchmarks the ratings should come from. The model-registry skill turns an intake file into a full registry.

createdAt.description: The time the wizard wrote the intake, as an ISO 8601 timestamp in UTC.

harnesses.description: The harness names the user runs, lowercase letters, digits and hyphens only.

artificialAnalysisKey.description: Whether an Artificial Analysis API key was saved in the key file. The key itself is never recorded here.

benchmarks.description: The benchmark ids the ratings should come from, in the wizard's catalog order.
